title: Wonderful
text: What a great day with Alex and Mickey!  They picked us up and dropped us back off promptly at our villa in Sitges! We had a wonderful bike ride through the countryside, stopping to learn about the vineyards and surrounding area.  Then we had a fascinating tour of one of the vineyards to learn how they have made Cava for 9 generations! Highly recommend this tour!
author: Navigator674214

title: Very enjoyable tour
text:
Our guide was very accomodading, knowledgable and in good spirits.
Was right on time picking us up at our hotel
author: j_hannesg2016

title: Great way to wile away a few hours - Loic, great Tour Leader
text: Loic, our tour leader was such a friendly. knowledgeable guy, made a huge difference. So lovely just cruising between Cava makers on the dusty lanes - with a great Cava stop. Montse gave us a great tour of her Cava vineyard, explained the process old and new, then let us taste 3 of her Cavas - all of which were superb. Highly recommend this tour. Great way to wile away a few hours.
author: SGou812

title: A lovely tour
text: Loic was the best tour guide! The bike ride was at a very comfortable pace with a lot of stops to point out things along the way. The winery tour and tasting was also such a unique and beautiful experience. Highly recommend doing this tour!
author: amandawA9767EP

title: Excellent cycling through picturesque area
text:
Alex picked us up punctually in Sitges and it was a short drive to the winery to pick up the bikes. The bikes were in good condition and the route was easy and mostly flat. Alex was knowledgeable about the area and the wine making process. The tastings were excellent and the tour really interesting. Alex was an excellent guide - friendly and relaxed.
Highly recommend this tour.
author: JimERead

title: Anonymous.
text: Next to the pool at the hotel there is a restaurant where a female chef and staff work. The woman is nice and cooks good food.
author: gamellah

title: Very nice biking in the vineyards.
text: Very nice tour with an excellent guide/host. Great bikes that was easy to ride. Had a very pleasant stop at the back of a local restaurant with some local wine in the shadow. Interesting to hear about the making of Cava and the different variations. Highly recommended this tour.
author: Jens L

title: Wine tour
text: We had a fantastic morning with Alex on the wine cycling tour. He was very informative and made the tour fun. I would highly recommend.
author: TONY P

title: CAVA!
text: This was a great experience with a nice group of people.  Alex, our guide, was knowledgeable ,  personable and kept us laughing.
author: Annette M

title: Great tour!
text: We did the bike + wine tour, with a group of 8 colleagues. It was a great experience! Very nice area to cycle and of course delicious cava. Alex shared some nice information and also the visit to the cellar was very interesting. Alex also booked a very nice place for lunch. Pick up and drop off was also well arranged. Good combination of excercise, drinks and food and enjoying the views!
